sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite their recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and face an Alsager side struggling badly near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games. This should present a good opportunity for the leaders to bounce back and extend their advantage at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to capitalise on Sandbach's stumble and close the 2-point gap at the top. Eccleshall entertain AFC Bridgnorth in a clash of third and fourth-placed sides, with Bridgnorth having won their last game. Wolverhampton Casuals, also in the promotion mix in fourth place, visit Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday before facing Brereton Social away on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town (sixth) host Foley Meir, while Barnton face Shawbury United—a side in alarming form with six consecutive losses. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town as mid-table sides seek vital points. Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in a basement battle between two struggling outfits, while Crewe entertain Allscott Heath and Widnes Town visit Brereton Social on Saturday, with the latter three all occupying lower-table positions.
